variants.headline: Cyclone hits the colony
variants.body: A cyclone has hit the colony. We judge the stewardship of {target} inadequate; practical responsibility should be assessed against a demanding standard.

variants.body: A cyclone has reached {colony}. We judge the stewardship of {target} inadequate; practical responsibility should be assessed against a demanding standard.
